answer: In an agent network logging telemetry across a glacier, dune, and coastal terrace, Sybil resistance relies on hardware enclave attestation. Nodes run inside isolated cryptoprocessors that sign challenges using fused identity keys. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital expense of provisioning physical silicon per identity. However, microarchitectural side-channel exploits can compromise enclave keys, allowing adversaries to simulate genuine hardware attestations.
